rafael_sre: probable coldstart fanout + per-IP heuristics. Ask them if they fetch ephemeral token inside handler.
owen_integration: they do `await fetch('/auth/ephemeral')` inside each request handler — yes.
lucy_devex: quick client patch: cache token in module scope + small startup jitter. small snippet below.
lucy_devex: ```js
// module scope
let _tok = null
let _exp = 0
async function getToken(){
  if(Date.now() < _exp && _tok) return _tok
  const r = await fetch('https://auth.neonpay.com/ephemeral')
  _tok = await r.text()
  _exp = Date.now() + 45000
  return _tok
}
// call on init
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.random()*150))
const session = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions',{ headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${await getToken()}`, 'x-service-id':'neonpay-node' } })
```
